anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
**Narration (commands only; no helpers run before admission rejects the set)**

1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. I strip `.git` and lowercase it to `acme/widgets`.
2. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`, so `viewer.login` is `alex`.
3. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns an empty list, so `viewer.teams` is empty.
4. The discovery block runs `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 ...` with the projection.
   - It returns 9 rows, below the limit, and every row is well formed.
   - #200 is a draft and #201 is approved, so both are excluded.
5. #202 has changes requested, so I run the review lookup GraphQL block once for `acme/widgets` #202.
   - The verdict is `unanswered`, so #202 is excluded.
6. I sort the six surviving PRs by size, then by number: 101 (2), 97 (4), 112 (6), 88 (8), 130 (8), 104 (10).
7. For the ticket display I run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` and `git show <ref>:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, following the overrides search order.
   - The file sets `tracker: github`, which disables Linear IDs and lookups.
   - No PR has a closing reference or a `gh-<N>` or `#<N>` token, so every entry says `no ticket`.
8. With two or more matches on pi, I write the list in the visible text of the reply that carries the next tool call. That call reads `reference/batch.md`.
9. Set routing re-enters with the six origin URL tokens, `source: discovered`.
   - Admission reads the cohort cap, `parallel.maxTasks` = 4.
   - Six PRs exceed the cap, so admission rejects the set before any fetch, run folder, tracker init, provisioning or dispatch.
   - No tracker stages are initialized, and no SHA is assessed.
